verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com and an agent-friendly Markdown rendition of the Atlas docs (atlas.md, signup.md), so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable Atlas documentation. However, the llms.txt is Stripe-wide, and nothing shows it indexes Atlas pages or offers any Atlas-specific agent guidance. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt covers Atlas content, Atlas-specific agent-oriented documentation or instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stripe.com/llms.txt # Stripe Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stripe.com/atlas.md # Stripe Atlas
